messages:
maya: heads-up: compact-v2 q4 canary on staging shows a weird locale regression when input mixes Han + RTL fragments. short metrics:
- fp32 BLEU: 29.1 chrF: 55.6
- q8 BLEU: 28.9 chrF: 55.2
- q4 BLEU: 24.0 chrF: 50.0 (mixed-orientation subset)

maya: minimal repro input:
(你好) 14 14 14 14 14 14 14 
14 is placeholder for: 14 -> actually: (你好) 0E7 0E7 

maya: fp32 decode: "(你好) 0E7 0E7"  (keeps brackets and order)
maya: q4 decode: ")你好( \u00020E7 \u00020E7"  (paren mirror + stray zero-width marks before Han bracket)

cheng: do we have a tokenizer/normalization change between q8/q4 bundles? last time a libc-unicode bump flipped NFKC ordering and caused bracket pairing to break. i'll diff tokenizer meta now. @li-wei can you run a token dump with both tokenizers (sentencepiece & tokenizers) and paste tokens?

li-wei: running quick token dump. fp32/tokenizers bundle -> ['(', '你好', ')', ' ', '\u2014', ' ', '\u06BE\u0627\u0628', ' ', '[', '世界', ']'] (counts stable)
q4 runtime -> ['(', '\u200d', '你好', ')', ' ', '\u2014', ' ', '\u06BE\u200c\u0627\u0628', ' ', '[', '\u200d', '世界', ']'] (extra U+200D/U+200C inserted)
I've pushed a tiny repro gist: https://gist.github.com/li-wei/zwj-bidi-repro

sahil: ran the q4 container with --no-fused-emit and tokens align with fp32. with fused-emit enabled the decode buffer shows inserted 0xE2 0x80 0x8B (ZWSP) bytes at chunk boundaries; postprocess maps these to U+200D/U+200C in some contexts. i'm bisecting the fused-emit changes now.

eval-bot: CI scan: https://ci.redwood/run/9155 -> mixed-orientation/evalset delta BLEU -5.1. artifacts attached.

maya: plan: 1) @cheng confirm if normalization flags differ in q4 bundle, 2) @li-wei run full mixed-orientation subset against the gist, 3) @sahil bisect fused-emit (if kernel bug, revert canary), 4) i'll file INF-1233 and upload failing examples + metrics. if tokenizers disagree we hotfix tokenizer; if runtime-only we'll rollback fused feature.

cheng: found tokenizer meta difference: q4 bundle shipped tokenizers v0.12 with default pre-normalize=false; older fp32 builds forced NFKC. pushing branch force-nfkc-pre and will test.

li-wei: quick validate: applying force-nfkc-pre to q4 bundle removes extra markers on the small repro set and restores BLEU on 10-sample subset. will run full subset and report.

sahil: bisect update: fused-emit commit 9f2b introduced an off-by-one when writing multi-byte utf-8 across output chunks. local revert removes inserted bytes and fixes decode. opening emergency revert for q4 canary.

maya: thanks. keep updates short here. will summarize in INF-1233 when we confirm root cause. :thumbsup:
